title: Stress selected-runtime threads, waits and lifecycle
goal: Exercise actual selected SDK thread/TLS/synchronization semantics beyond the initial native callback contracts.
acceptance: Test TLS/r13 and stack bounds, create/suspend/resume/terminate, events/semaphores/mutexes, timeout/cancel paths, atomics/order and repeated teardown
Use deterministic barriers and bounded waits instead of sleeps hiding races; preserve resource/handle accounting and distinct per-process profiles
Investigate the retained aggregate-suite shared-state failures and report unresolved causes; do not turn process isolation into a claimed fix
validation: Run seeded contention and create/wait/cancel/shutdown stress with leak/deadline checks
Run supported sanitizers and mutation/timeout negatives; document host callbacks versus any translated instructions separately
